CustomField.description: When checked, the section renders a header above its content. For Field Set/Repeater/Table the header is drawn inside c-flow-form / c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table; for Flow, Display Text, and Lightning Web Component types it is drawn by c-header. The header uses Header Title, Subtitle, Icon Name, Top Margin, Header Text, and Header Text Variant. Defaults to false.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to show a header (title, subtitle, icon, and optional rich text) above this section's content. The header's text and icon come from the Header fields on the Header tab; leave off for a header-less section.
CustomField.label: Display Header
